model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values over iterations for several language models. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick labels spaced approximately every 10000 units. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and displays a linear scale from approximately 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels spaced approximately every 0.1 units. Five lines are plotted: a red line representing “Vanilla,” a blue line representing “StrmLLM (n=64),” a dark orange line representing “StrnLLM (n=64),” a green line representing “SepLLM (n=64),” a pink line representing "SepLLM (n=64, H)," and a black line representing “SepLLM (n=128).” At iteration 0, the loss values for all lines are approximately 2.6. At iteration 140000, the loss values are approximately 2.8 for “Vanilla,” 2.9 for “StrmLLM (n=64),” 3.0 for “StrnLLM (n=64),” 3.1 for “SepLLM (n=64),” 3.2 for “SepLLM (n=64, H), and 3.3 for “SepLLM (n=128).”
